_how_to_edit.ar: لتعديل المنيو: غيّر الاسم أو السعر داخل هذا الملف فقط ثم احفظه. لإخفاء صنف مؤقتًا اجعل "available": false. لا تحذف الفواصل أو علامات التنصيص.
_how_to_edit.en: To edit the menu: change a name or price in this file and save it. To hide an item for now, set "available": false. Keep the commas and quote marks exactly as they are.

source_summary: All items and prices were copied from the restaurant's own online menu at https://thiqat-alshaam.menus-sa.com/ar (linked as the website on the restaurant's Google Maps listing). Prices are marked 'unconfirmed' until the owner confirms them in store. Item photos are the ones the restaurant uses on that same menu (approved for use by the site owner on 2026-11-21); see credits.json. HungerStation delivery prices, calories and most item descriptions were added on 2026-11-22 (fields price_hungerstation, calories_hungerstation, description_source).
